Class NominalFluentNode

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sabre.hg.Node
edu.uky.cs.nil.sabre.hg.FormulaNode
edu.uky.cs.nil.sabre.hg.FluentNode
edu.uky.cs.nil.sabre.hg.NominalFluentNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
CostSet, Countable, Serializable, Iterable<CostSet.Entry>
public class NominalFluentNode extends FluentNode
A fluent node representing a non-numeric fluent, which is any fluent that has a discrete, finite set of possible values.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • getGroup

      protected List<PreconditionNode> getGroup(Value value)
      Returns the value group for a given value. A value group is all precondition nodes that will have a finite cost once this node's fluent has a finite cost for some value. It is a list of nodes where the first node is always an equal to precondition node with this node's fluent on the left and a constant node for the group's value on the right. All other nodes in the list are not equal to precondition nodes with this node's fluent on the left and some other value on the right.
      Parameters:
      value - the value whose group of precondition nodes is desired
      Returns:
      a list of precondition nodes which will have a finite cost once this node's fluent has a finite cost for that value

    • getCost

      public double getCost(Value value)
      Description copied from interface: CostSet
      Returns the cost associated with the given value, which is an estimate of the number of actions that need to be taken from the state a heuristic graph was initialized to before the logical expression this set represents can have the given value. A cost of 0 means the logical expression has this value from the start. A cost of positive infinity means the expression cannot have this value.
      Parameters:
      value - a value the logical expression this set represents might have
      Returns:
      an estimate of the number of actions that would need to be taken before this set can contain that value

    • getCost

      public double getCost(Comparison.Operator operator, Value value)
      Description copied from interface: CostSet
      Returns the cost of some value in this set satisfying the given comparison operator when it is on the left and a given value is on the right. For example, if this method is called with the greater than operator and the value 0, it means "what is the cost of this set having a value above 0?"
      Parameters:
      operator - the comparison operator to satisfy
      value - the value on the right hand side of the comparison
      Returns:
      the cost of some value in this set that satisfies the comparison when it is on the left hand side of the comparison

    • setCost

      public boolean setCost(Value value, double cost)
      Description copied from class: FluentNode
      Sets the cost of this node's fluent having the given value. The value's cost will only be updated if the given cost is less than the current cost of that value.
      Overrides:
      setCost in class FluentNode
      Parameters:
      value - a value that the fluent can now have
      cost - the cost of the fluent having that value
      Returns:
      true if the cost of that value was updated, or false if this node's state did not change
